Combine questions into a question set

Source: R/questions.R
laya_questions.Rd

Combine questions into a question set

Usage

laya_questions(...)

Arguments

...

Named questions built with laya_choice(), laya_score() or laya_noul(). The names are the question ids used in the results.

Value

A laya_questions object: a named list of questions in the Python SDK's format.

See also

as_laya_questions() to import a Python question set, and laya_questions_to_json() to export one.

Examples

qs <- laya_questions(
  department = laya_choice("Which department?", billing = "refunds", technical = "bugs"),
  urgency = laya_score("How urgent?", c("low", "high")),
  churn_risk = laya_noul("Does the user threaten to cancel?")
)
qs
#> <laya_questions> 3 questions
#>   department  choice Which department?  [2 options: billing, technical]
#>   urgency     score  How urgent?  [2 levels]
#>   churn_risk  noul   Does the user threaten to cancel?  [yes/no]
